meta.triageRationale: One minor change with one obvious approach in one module, on top of the just-shipped lanes (Story b94cf2c9): the summary lane waits for an idle index lane before each job, and a running sweep waits the same way before each document and edit.

body.summary: Code work comes first, checked next to every summary start. Queue: waitForIndexIdle resolves once the index lane has no job running or queued, or on stop(); the summary lane loops on isIndexIdle before taking a job, no await after the last check. Sweep, per document: wait for code work, check shutdown, run an edit queued meanwhile, read the document, then check shutdown (fixed @0cf92d04) and code work again - stop, or go back to the wait - and summarise with no await after those checks. Single-document summary: after its read it waits out code work, returns on shutdown, summarises with no await after the last check. The single-document test now states what it covers (waits while code runs, resumes after it, not started on shutdown). Thirteen mutations, including every defect the gate found, each fail the tests.
